Who we are

Human connection.
At the heart of every insight.

Mable Enterprise delivers quantitative and qualitative data collection and research solutions for research agencies, consulting firms, media agencies, non-profits and corporate brands.

Our skilled researchers, digital tools and broad enumerator network bring you closer to the people behind the numbers. We listen carefully, engage meaningfully and uncover the insights that inform better decisions.

Our mission: To provide quality data and insights that enable decisions, create positive change and improve business performance.
